findings.summary: The separate stdio App Server route cannot resume the thread after Desktop becomes active writer. That route is rejected for the product contract. The finding does not apply automatically to the newly observed owner-follower IPC route, which delegates to Desktop rather than attempting writer handoff.

The read response omitted projectId and project-filtered listing did not find the task, but cwd lookup and exact thread/read succeeded. No documented contract requires identifier equality, so this is not evidence of project incompatibility.
Existing artifact dedupe key lacks bridge request/turn identity and cannot serve M2-DESKTOP unchanged.
The tested managed-daemon startup route cannot start from the installed binaries without a complete local package. This limits that route only and creates no requirement to install a daemon for MVP2.

The pinned Python SDK 0.144.4 cannot parse a functionCallOutput item emitted by installed App Server 0.155.0-alpha.9.2. The owner-IPC adapter therefore does not use that SDK and validates the pinned raw JSON profile directly; live compatibility is still tracked separately.

Foreground Remote Control connects without daemon installation, but official documentation exposes Remote Connections to ChatGPT mobile and supported desktop clients and does not provide a third-party Telegram client contract or attachment to Desktop's private writer.

The existing global notifier automatically sent two probe-turn completion messages despite the no-Telegram experiment boundary, and its current contract has no per-task exclusion. Further live turns require an authorized compatible notifier extension or exact permission for the expected notification; global notifier state must not be disabled or cleared.

Desktop owner IPC connectivity and owner discovery are proven for 26.915.4065.0, but a real follower start-turn ACK, history/event completeness and reconnect have not been run. The protocol is private and version-bound; mismatch must fail closed without another executor.

Read-only UIA exposes exact semantic project/create/open controls, but it is unproven whether invoking new task yields a conversation owner before the first prompt. The live probe must resolve this without coordinates or arbitrary active-window input.

Response methods exist and are covered by offline owner-targeting tests, but receipt and correlation of every pending question/approval family, expiry and Desktop race are not proven on the running app.

The first Telegram-driven create attempt ended unknown_dispatch because the exact Create task control was offscreen. Commit 3ea2438 scrolls it into view before Invoke and fails closed without ScrollItem; the post-fix live create was not run.

After application rebind, startup correctly rejected backups bound to the previous code. The recovery reset passed, but the scheduled cold-start backup cycle returned 1 and its exact failing boundary remains unknown.

Telegram request e18a5ca3-95d3-4be8-8453-630d88e97a50 is terminal unknown_dispatch. Read-only Desktop inspection found no created task; the request remains preserved and must not be replayed or edited manually.

The three-commit candidate has not completed post-fix live D01-D17 or one frozen independent L1/L2/L3. Local implementation, deployment attempt, activation, publication and acceptance remain separate states.
